donor_policy: Own visible paint and listed exact same-material neighbours; when own count <40 and no local neighbour, use the same part's visible paint in the paired view
palette_policy: Own visible RGB when >=40 pixels; otherwise local same-material neighbours, then the approved same-part cross-view fallback; seeded weighted RGB k-means
outline_policy: Filled pixels on the four-connected boundary of the whole part only; alpha unchanged

trousers_policy.donors: view trousers core plus own still-owned original visible pixels; no coat, tabard or cross-view source
trousers_policy.quantization: k6 sampled palette; hidden interiors use only centroids within the director's material DeltaE limit; outlines retain their tone

value_distribution_policy.basis: Same-view same-part visible pixels; sparse references reported explicitly pending design decision
value_distribution_policy.quantization: Empirical same-part visible L* quantiles assigned in diffusion L* order; nearest sampled k6 palette centroid; include unchanged outline in median gate
